nodes.description: Private mapping tracking how many sales each address has performed; gates condition() and is incremented in transferFrom.
Private whitelist mapping allowing addresses to bypass the sale-condition restriction in ensure().
Private minimum sale amount enforced by condition(); written by init().
Private maximum sale amount enforced by condition(); written by init().
Private number of allowed sales per address; written by init() and read by condition().
Address whitelisted inside ensure(); writable only by owner via setTradeAddress().
Public token balance mapping, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom() and batchSend().
Public nested allowance mapping, decremented in transferFrom() without SafeMath.
Constant token decimals (18) used to scale amounts in init().
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Private privileged address set to msg.sender at deployment; gate for init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address used as a trusted whitelisted sender in ensure().
Public payable transfer wrapper that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist check: owner, UNI router, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses bypass condition(); otherwise condition() must pass.
Public payable transfer entry point: spends allowance, calls ensure(), then mutates balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale restriction enforcing _minSale, _maxSale and per-address _saleNum limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall into attacker-selected address with raw calldata.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with unchecked scaling arithmetic.
Owner-only batch distribution; computes total by unchecked multiplication and decrements balanceOf without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter updating the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address derivation using CREATE2 init code hash.
Payable constructor minting totalSupply to msg.sender, setting owner and granting infinite allowance to the UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, ownership and allowance accounting throughout Happinu.
a.delegatecall(b) executes attacker-supplied code in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath in transferFrom().
total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total performed without overflow protection in batchSend().
require(msg.sender == owner) single-key authorization used by init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Transfer amount parameter of transferFrom().
Payer address parameter of transferFrom(), user-influenced and passed to ensure().
Target address parameter of the delegatecall in delegate().
Raw calldata bytes parameter forwarded to the delegatecall in delegate().
Array of recipient addresses iterated over in batchSend().
New whitelist address assigned to tradeAddress.
Number of sales per address parameter written to _saleNum in init().
Minimum sale parameter scaled by decimals and stored in _minSale.
Maximum sale parameter scaled by decimals and stored in _maxSale.
Local variable holding the pairFor() derived Uniswap pair address compared against _from in ensure().
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed without overflow checks in batchSend().
Loop counter over _tos in batchSend().

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument when transfer() forwards to transferFrom().
transfer() delegates all value movement to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether the allowance spend is authorized in transferFrom().
transferFrom() invokes ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
transferFrom() performs balanceOf decrement/increment with raw uint arithmetic feeding the unchecked-balance operation.
balanceOf mapping is read and written by the unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom() without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and decremented inside transferFrom().
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every successful transfer.
ensure() calls condition(_from,_value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address for whitelist comparison.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound per-address sales.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] and compares it with _saleNum.
ensure() reads the canSale whitelist mapping for the sender.
ensure() reads tradeAddress to decide whether the sender is exempt from condition().
ensure() compares _from and _to against the owner storage slot for whitelist bypass.
pairFor() output is captured in the local _UNI variable inside ensure().
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate() authorizes solely on msg.sender == owner, a single unprotected key.
delegate() forwards arbitrary calldata to an attacker-chosen address via delegatecall, executing in this contract's storage context.
delegate() reads the owner slot to validate the caller.
init() is gated only by msg.sender == owner.
init() writes the scaled _minSale value.
init() writes the scaled _maxSale value.
init() writes _saleNum from user-supplied saleNum.
init() reads decimals to scale _minSale and _maxSale.
batchSend() is gated only by msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it without SafeMath, enabling overflow.
batchSend() mutates balanceOf entries directly with unchecked arithmetic.
setTradeAddress() is gated only by msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress storage slot.
The constructor uses msg.sender as the deployer/initial holder.
The constructor stores msg.sender into the owner slot.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
The constructor seeds balanceOf[msg.sender] with the entire supply.
The constructor grants infinite allowance to the UNI router address.
transferFrom() checks and decrements balanceOf[_from] using raw arithmetic instead of SafeMath.
batchSend() iterates over the caller-supplied _tos array.
_to parameter flows into the transferFrom call inside transfer().
_value parameter flows into the allowance and balance accounting of transferFrom().
_from parameter flows into ensure(), the allowance spend and the balance updates.
Address parameter a becomes the delegatecall target in delegate().
Bytes parameter b is the raw calldata used by the delegatecall in delegate().
addr parameter is assigned to tradeAddress in setTradeAddress().
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init().
token parameter is scaled by decimals and stored into _minSale by init().
maxToken parameter is scaled by decimals and stored into _maxSale by init().
batchSend() defines the local total used for the balance check and subtraction.
batchSend() defines the loop counter i used to walk _tos.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only exists as an argument of transfer(); it is subsumed by transfer's flow to transferFrom.
The _value parameter only exists inside transferFrom() and is subsumed by its allowance and balance updates.
The _from parameter only exists inside transferFrom() and is subsumed by its ensure() and balance logic.
Address parameter a has no meaning apart from the delegatecall performed in delegate().
Bytes parameter b has no meaning apart from the calldata executed by the delegatecall in delegate().
The _tos array is only consumed by the batchSend() distribution loop.
The addr parameter only serves to set the tradeAddress state variable in setTradeAddress().
saleNum is a transient init() argument that is immediately persisted into _saleNum.
token is a transient init() argument that is immediately scaled into _minSale.
maxToken is a transient init() argument that is immediately scaled into _maxSale.
Local _UNI is a temporary computed inside ensure() only to be compared against _from.
Local total is a temporary of batchSend() used only for its unchecked balance check and subtraction.
Loop counter i is a temporary of batchSend() with no meaning outside the distribution loop.
